definitions.gloss: mixing and matching clothes; wearing one item many ways
definitions.explanation: Combining a small number of clothes in different ways so that they make many outfits. A favourite word of fashion magazines, which praise items that are {着回|きまわ}しが{利|き}く (easy to mix and match).

examples.japanese: {着回|きまわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧。
examples.english: Clothes that are easy to mix and match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着回|きまわ}しやすい。
examples.english: A white shirt goes with almost anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着回|きまわ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: On trips I take only three pieces of clothing that I can mix and match.

notes:
From {着回|きまわ}す (to wear the same clothes in rotation, combining them in different ways).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着回|きまわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧: easy to mix and match, versatile
- {着回|きまわ}し{力|りょく}: versatility (of a garment)
- ⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着回|きまわ}し: a week of outfits from a few items

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コーデ→コーデ：17567_koode⟧: an outfit, a coordinated look; {着回|きまわ}し is about getting many such outfits from few clothes
